resources.string: Sign in below to get started.
The check is about to start. No need to press again.
It will start by itself as soon as the phone connects to a Wi-Fi network.
It will start by itself as soon as the phone is online.
You can close the app: it keeps going on its own.
New files are uploaded automatically: usually right away, and in any case %1$s.
Automatic upload is on: I am rescheduling it now.
Files are uploaded only when you press “Upload now”.
Last check: %1$s — nothing new to upload
Reading the file list from the server…
Comparing with the server: %1$d of %2$d files
Reading the files on the phone…
%1$d already on the server · %2$d uploaded by this app · %3$d waiting
On: new files are uploaded by themselves
Off: files are uploaded only with “Upload now”
On mobile data nothing is uploaded
Also uploads on mobile data (can use a lot of data)
Tells you when files have been uploaded (errors are always reported)
Only tells you when something goes wrong
Checks %1$s whether anything needs uploading. An empty check costs very little battery. It is the longest delay before a file starts if the system does not notify the app. Tap to change.

The app compares the phone\'s photos with those already on the server and uploads only the missing ones. If there are many it can take time and data: better on Wi-Fi. If you also upload photos with the official Seafile app, files already there are not uploaded again.
Now uploading: %1$s. Press “Upload now” to start right away
No files found: allow access to photos and videos
%1$s. Like OneDrive: the date is the one in the file name, otherwise the date taken. Files already uploaded stay where they are. Tap to change.

The app asks the server to revoke this phone\'s sign-in and deletes the token from the phone; automatic upload stops. If the server cannot be reached, revoke the device from Seafile (web) → settings → connected devices.
So it works in the background
No restrictions: background upload is not stopped
Restricted: the phone may stop the upload. Tap to fix
No restrictions: all good. On Samsung also check that the app is not among the “sleeping” ones.
Only some files: tap and choose “Allow all”
Missing: tap to allow access to %1$s
Open “Permissions”, then “Photos and videos” and choose “Allow all”
Off: you will not see progress or errors. Tap to turn on
Redo the comparison with the server
Reads the file list on the server again and compares it with the phone\'s files
Redo the comparison with the server?
The app reads the file list on the server again and compares it with the phone\'s files, then uploads only what is missing. Needed if you changed library, folder, album or file type.
Save the registry to a file
So you do not lose the memory of what was already uploaded if you reinstall the app or change phone. The file is not encrypted (it lists your file names): keep it private
Restore the registry from a file

The file contains %1$d files (library “%2$s”, folder %3$s). Existing rows are replaced. The settings saved in the file (folder, albums, file type, subfolders, frequency, Wi-Fi, language) are restored too; the sign-in is not, so sign in again first. The app will still redo the comparison with the server, without re-uploading anything already there.
not a Seafile Big Upload registry

Type the two-factor code right before pressing “Sign in”: it only lasts a few seconds. If sign-in fails, do not retry several times: after 3 errors the server asks for a captcha and also blocks the other apps.
Signed in. Now turn on “Automatic upload”
%1$s\n\nDo not retry several times: after 3 errors the server asks for a captcha and also blocks the other apps. The button stays off for a minute.
Or sign in with the single sign-on of your server (for example Google): the app opens your server\'s sign-in page and never sees your password. Type the server address above first.
The page could not be loaded (%1$s) on %2$s. Check the connection and the server address.
The server %2$s answered with an error (HTTP %1$d). Single sign-on may not be enabled for this account: ask the server administrator.
The security certificate of %1$s is not valid: sign-in stopped.
%1$s\n\nThe sign-in token was not accepted by the server and has been discarded.
Started: checking files and uploading the missing ones
Stop requested: it stops at the end of the current chunk
Automatic upload on: checking files now
Automatic upload off: files are uploaded only with “Upload now”
Will upload on mobile data too: watch your data
I will notify you when it finishes
No notice when all goes well (errors are always reported)

Automatically uploads your phone\'s videos and photos to your own Seafile server, even when a service like Cloudflare in front of the server refuses large files: it sends them in chunks, checks them one by one and keeps a registry of what has already been uploaded.
Report a problem or ask for a feature

The password is not saved. The sign-in token is encrypted with a key that never leaves the phone. The app only talks to the server you entered; if you sign in with Google, Google\'s sign-in page opens through your server. Nobody else receives anything.
